changes.tagline: Deepfake detection and AI watermarking, plus free open-source Chatterbox voice models
changes.description: Resemble AI now focuses on detecting deepfake audio, video, and images in real time and on watermarking AI content for provenance. It no longer sells voice generation to new customers, but its open-source Chatterbox text-to-speech models remain free under the MIT license.
changes.longDescription: Resemble AI began as a voice cloning company and in August 2026 shifted its business to deepfake defense, ending commercial voice generation for new customers. Its Detect models flag AI-generated audio, video, and images with explainable results, Watermarker embeds provenance markers with C2PA support, and identity tools enroll and authenticate voices. Detection plugs into telephony and meeting platforms for contact centers, banks, and media teams, with cloud, on-premises, or air-gapped deployment. Developers can still use Chatterbox, the company's MIT-licensed open-source text-to-speech family, for free.
changes.seoDescription: Resemble AI review: real-time deepfake detection and AI watermarking, plus free open-source Chatterbox voice models. Compare pricing and alternatives.
changes.metaKeywords: Resemble AI, Resemble AI review, Resemble AI pricing, Resemble AI alternatives, Deepfake detection, Resemble Detect, AI watermarking, Chatterbox, Enterprise, On-prem
changes.moreContext:
Resemble AI is a rare case of a voice technology company turning its expertise toward catching fakes. Founded in 2019 as a voice cloning startup, it announced in August 2026 that it had stopped offering voice generation as a commercial product and would focus on multimodal deepfake detection and watermarking. The company argues that knowing how synthetic voices are built at the model level makes it better at spotting them.

- Its Detect models flag AI-generated audio, video and images in real time, and an Intelligence layer explains results in plain language.
- Watermarker embeds imperceptible provenance markers in media and supports C2PA standards.
- Identity tools enroll and authenticate voices, which helps contact centers and banks guard against impersonation.
- Detection plugs into telephony platforms like Twilio, Five9 and Genesys, plus Microsoft Teams, Zoom, Google Meet and Webex.
- Chatterbox, the company's open-source text-to-speech family, stays free under the MIT license, and its multilingual version covers more than 20 languages.

Resemble AI is best for enterprises, contact centers, financial institutions and media teams that need to verify what is real. Plans start with pay-as-you-go credits, while Team and Business subscriptions add seats, and deployment can be cloud-based, on-premises or fully air-gapped, with SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001 credentials. Tip: if you are evaluating detection, pilot it inside an existing call or meeting workflow first, since real traffic reveals far more about fit than test clips do.

note: Rewritten around detection and watermarking (voice-cloning page confirms 'no longer available'); Team $350/mo, Business $1,000/mo, $0 pay-as-you-go Flex; Chatterbox free.
